title: US Border Patrol Sets All-Time Record With 21,471 Agents Serving - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
United States Border Patrol agents monitor the southern border outside of San Diego on May 27, 2026. John Fredricks/The Epoch Times
U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) reported 21,471 Border Patrol agents are currently serving on the front lines, the highest employee count in the 102-year history of the agency.
